_note: Paper-only strategy variants run side by side on the same live data. Edit and save; the bot reloads within a minute and logs the change. Stakes above $10 are clipped in code.

main.desc: Headline bot: model blended 50/50 with market price, 4c min edge, only 90-240s left, asks 20-80c, $1 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $10, cap $2 when ask >70c

main_minfill.desc: Same as main, but if the edge-sized bet is under the 5-share minimum, round up to 5 shares when that costs $3 or less

model_early.desc: Pure price model (no market blend), needs 8c edge, only 120-240s left (backtest's best pocket), cap $10

blend_wide.desc: Blend model+market, lower 3c edge, any time from 30s to 240s left, cap $10

legacy_fixed.desc: Control: today's original rules (3c edge, $1 +$1 per 1c, up to $10, any time) but with the fixed probability math

ride_favorite.desc: Like trading by hand: buy whichever side the market favors at 70-85c with 60-120s left, flat $10 (raised from $4.50 on Nov 16; shares capped so cost+fee <= $10), no model

trend_volume.desc: Trend + structure + volume: bets only WITH the last hour's trend when momentum (60m and 15m agree), higher-highs/higher-lows (or lower/lower) over four 15-min chunks, and heavier volume on trend candles all agree; sits out when choppy or very volatile. Estimate = 50/50 model+market +3c trend bonus, needs 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 30-75c, cap $5

breakout.desc: Breakout: a finished 1-min candle closed above the prior 30-min high (or below the low) on >=2x the average volume, and price is still past that level. Bets the breakout direction. Estimate = 50/50 model+market +3c, needs 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 25-80c, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $10 ($4 above 70c)

contrarian.desc: DISABLED Nov 17 (no new bets; history kept). Contrarian: when the favorite is 90c+ (underdog 2-10c), buy the underdog. Flat $2 (these mostly lose; one win pays 10-50x). 90-240s left so there is still time for a reversal. No model

scale_in.desc: Scale-in: first bet $3 on the side the 50/50 model+market blend favors (3c edge, 150-240s left, asks 30-75c, last 15 min must move the same way). Then up to 2 adds of $3 each, at least 30s apart with 60s+ left, only if BTC is $15+ further past the price to beat than at the last fill AND our side's price rose 2c+ (max 90c). Whole round incl. fees <= $10

trend_spike.desc: Stricter trend_volume: ALL its conditions plus a volume spike (last 5 min volume >=1.5x the hour's 5-min average, >=3 of 5 candles in trend direction), structure 2 of 3 chunk steps, 60/15/5-min moves all agree, with-trend volume >=1.5x. 120-210s left, asks 35-70c, >=5c edge after fee, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee. (Spec was 2.0x spike and 3 of 3 steps; loosened because a 4-day live-candle check showed it would almost never fire.)

guarded_favorite.desc: Guarded favorite: buys the market favorite (60-85c) with 60-180s left ONLY when trend_volume's trend, structure and volume filters all point the same way as the favorite (same chop/volatility skips). Needs >=2c edge after fee on the 50/50 blend + 3c trend bonus. $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee, max_loss_per_bet $10

breakout_scale.desc: Breakout + scale: breakout signal (1-min close past the prior 30-min high/low on >=2x average volume, price still past it) AND scale_in's confirmation (last 15 min same way, >=3c edge after fee on the 50/50 model+market blend, asks 30-75c, 120-240s left). $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge. May add once (BTC $15+ further past the price to beat and our side up 2c+, 60s+ left); round total incl. fees <= $5. After a losing round: skip next 2 qualifying setups AND at least 15 min, whichever is longer

ultimate.desc: Ultimate: ALL trend_volume filters (hour momentum + same 15-min direction, higher highs/lows or lower/lower, with-trend volume >=1.15x, chop and volatility skips), trend direction only. >=3c edge after fee (50/50 blend + 3c trend bonus), asks 30-75c, 90-240s left. $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge. One add on scale_in's rule (BTC $15+ further past the price to beat, our side up 2c+, 60s+ left); round incl. fees <= $5; max_loss_per_bet 10 enforced. After a losing round: skip next 2 qualifying setups AND at least 15 min, whichever is longer

meta.desc: Meta: copies the recent leader. Scores every other active variant by 3-hour return (net P&L / dollars bet, needs 5+ settled bets); the best positive one leads once it has led 2 straight checks (one per round). If the leader's rules say bet, meta copies that side at its own size ($2, +$1 if leader's 3h return >10%, +$1 more if >20%, max $4 incl. fee); else falls back to the #2 positive variant if it fires. Sits out when nobody is positive. Loss cooldown: skip next 2 qualifying setups AND 15 min. max_loss_per_bet 10
